title: OpenAI Baselines: ACKTR & A2C
summary: We’re releasing two new OpenAI Baselines implementations: ACKTR and A2C. A2C is a synchronous, deterministic variant of Asynchronous Advantage Actor Critic (A3C) which we’ve found gives equal performance. ACKTR is a more sample-efficient reinforcement learning algorithm than TRPO and A2C, and requires only slightly more computation than A2C per update.
body: We’re releasing two new OpenAI Baselines implementations: ACKTR and A2C. A2C is a synchronous, deterministic variant of Asynchronous Advantage Actor Critic (A3C) which we’ve found gives equal performance. ACKTR is a more sample-efficient reinforcement learning algorithm than TRPO and A2C, and requires only slightly more computation than A2C per update.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了ACKTR和A2C两种强化学习算法的实现。A2C作为A3C的同步确定性变体，在保持性能的同时简化了实现；ACKTR则通过更高效的样本利用率，在计算开销略微增加的情况下，显著优于TRPO和A2C。这些工具的开源为强化学习研究者提供了更高效的基准测试与训练手段，有助于加速相关算法的迭代与落地。

glossary.explanationZh: 一种基于Kronecker-factored近似的信任域强化学习算法。
同步优势演员-评论家算法，是A3C的同步版本。
样本效率，指算法在较少数据下达到目标性能的能力。
强化学习，通过奖励机制训练智能体决策的机器学习方法。
